name: Stalwart
descr: Play the Stalwart if you want to take heavy blows and keep fighting.

foundations.name: Unwavering
foundations.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your damage thresholds.

foundations.name: Iron Will
foundations.text: When you take physical damage, you can **mark an additional Armor Slot** to reduce the severity.

specializations.name: Unrelenting
specializations.text: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

specializations.name: Partners-in-Arms
specializations.text: When an ally within Very Close range takes damage, you can **mark an Armor Slot** to reduce the severity by one threshold.

masteries.name: Undaunted
masteries.text: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your damage thresholds.

masteries.name: Loyal Protector
masteries.text: When an ally within Close range has 2 or fewer Hit Points and would take damage, you can **mark a Stress** to sprint to their side and take the damage instead.
